standard.summary: 经典 DoRA 每行权重有自己可学的幅度向量。打开后改成整层共享一个可学标量，骑在冻结的初始行范数上。
standard.effect: 默认关 = 经典 DoRA。打开后可学参数大幅减少（每层 1 个代替每行 1 个），表达力也降低；初始行为不变。
standard.whenToUse: 想让 DoRA 的幅度部分几乎不占训练预算、只做轻微整体伸缩时。
standard.avoidWhen: 想完整复刻论文行为或追求最好质量时不要开。

standard_en.summary: Classic DoRA learns a magnitude vector per output row. Enabling this replaces it with a single learnable scalar per layer, riding on the frozen initial row norms.
standard_en.effect: Default off = classic DoRA. On, the trainable magnitude shrinks to one parameter per layer instead of one per row, with lower expressiveness; initial behaviour is unchanged.
standard_en.whenToUse: When you want the magnitude side to cost almost nothing and only apply a light global scaling.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Do not enable when you need faithful paper behaviour or maximum quality.
